jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.content: <p>Monzo builds forecasting tools for retailers.</p><h3>The role</h3><p>You will work as a Data Scientist: build, evaluate and deploy machine learning models in Python and SQL for our pricing team, and explain the results to commercial colleagues.</p><ul><li>Python, SQL and scikit-learn</li><li>Experience with experiment design</li><li>Clear communication</li></ul><p></p><p>In this role you will own the full life cycle of your models: framing the business question with colleagues in pricing and operations, preparing the data, comparing approaches with proper validation, shipping the chosen model behind a small service and watching its accuracy in production every week. You will write clear documentation, review other people's code and share what you learn with the team in our fortnightly sessions.</p><p>We review applications as they arrive and reply to everyone who applies.</p>
